caption:
The AI gold rush is officially leaving the screen and putting on safety goggles. Former OpenAI science lead Kevin Weil just launched Warp Sciences with a whopping $215 million led by Lightspeed, using robots and sensor gloves to automate lab work. Instead of outsourcing to contractors, they're reshoring the grind so robots can synthesize compounds around the clock. At this rate, your next prescription is going to be coded by a machine that never sleeps and probably doesn't drink coffee either. Would you trust a drug synthesized by a robot on the night shift? Let's talk in the comments. 🤖💊 #WarpSciences #OpenAI #ArtificialIntelligence #TechNews #StartupFunding #FutureOfWork

Source: TechCrunch
